units.source_text: 女人站在幽暗之中，比幽暗更黑暗。

en.t: The woman stood in the gloom, darker than the gloom itself.

units.source_text: 他让女人搀扶着，拖着步子往睡觉的地方走去，可他怎么一点都看不见女人。

en.t: Supported by the woman, he dragged his feet toward the place where he slept, yet somehow he could not see her at all.

units.source_text: 不，不仅是女人，所有的轮廓都模模糊糊看不清。

en.t: No, it was not only the woman; every outline was blurred and impossible to make out.

units.source_text: 尽管倒在了被窝上，他心里似乎还拼命地在沙丘上奔跑……

en.t: Even after collapsing onto the bedding, in his mind he still seemed to be running desperately over the dunes...

units.source_text: 持续不断，就连梦里都在不停地跑……

en.t: It went on without stopping; even in his dreams he kept on running...

units.source_text: 就因为这缘故，他的睡眠很浅。

en.t: Because of that, his sleep was very shallow.

units.source_text: 大网篮来往的声音，远处狗的叫唤，全都原封不动地留在了记忆里。

en.t: The sound of the large basket coming and going, the barking of dogs in the distance, all remained in his memory exactly as they were.

units.source_text: 女人回来吃夜宵，点上了他枕边的油灯，这一切，他都知道得清清楚楚。

en.t: He knew perfectly well that the woman had come back to eat a late-night meal and had lit the oil lamp beside his pillow.

units.source_text: 睡到半夜，他起来喝了口水，于是，就再也睡不着了。

en.t: In the middle of the night he got up and took a sip of water, and after that he could no longer fall asleep.

units.source_text: 虽说如此，但他还没有力气去帮女人干活。

en.t: Even so, he still did not have the strength to help the woman with her work.
